name: prefix_ratio64k

validation.pairing: all eight held-out real choices for every held-out noise state

feature: unchanged native base_model_depth8; token RMS then pooled first and second moments
normalization: one training mixture mean and one global RMS; positive/negative sides each weight one half
prior: unchanged generalized Bayes N(0,I/dim), unit expected f^2 on the normalized training mixture
ridge_rule: dim/N independent generated states, including regularized bias; N=64000
objective: average paired scaled logistic over states and five balanced positive choices, plus one prior
validation_entry: mean conditional risk + 2 SE of 1000 class means < 0; optimizer gradient maxabs <1e-5
validation_uncertainty_limit: descriptive class-cluster SE under fixed balanced classes; not a formal guarantee

sampling_if_entry_passed.requires: input gradient audit, finite whole trajectory and original official8 pixel parity
